data.additional_information:
About the Role:
We are seeking a highly motivated Research Intern from IITs or IIITH or IISc to join our AI Research team and work at the intersection of Knowledge Graphs, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Mechanical Engineering.
The objective of this internship is to develop intelligent systems that leverage Knowledge Graphs and Generative AI to enhance engineering workflows across the product lifecycle, including mechanical design, simulation, manufacturing, production, quality, and engineering knowledge management.
The intern will research and build AI solutions that can capture engineering knowledge, reason over complex product data, support engineers in decision-making, and enable natural language interactions with engineering systems and repositories.
________________________________________
Key Responsibilities:
Research
• Conduct research on the application of:
o Knowledge Graphs (KGs), Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Graph-Based Reasoning, Engineering AI Systems
• Study and reproduce state-of-the-art research relevant to:
o Engineering Knowledge Representation ,Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Digital Engineering, Design Automation, Manufacturing Intelligence, Industrial AI
• Investigate methods for combining Knowledge Graphs and LLMs for engineering problem solving.
Knowledge Graph Development
• Design and develop knowledge graphs representing:
o Mechanical components, Product structures (BOMs), Design rules, Manufacturing processes, Simulation models, Engineering standards, Failure and quality data
• Develop ontology models for engineering domains.
• Build pipelines for extracting structured knowledge from:
o CAD metadata, Engineering documents, Technical standards, Simulation reports, Manufacturing records
• Integrate graph databases and graph reasoning frameworks.
LLM Engineering
• Develop LLM-powered applications for engineering use cases.
• Build Graph-RAG systems that combine Knowledge Graphs with LLMs.
• Fine-tune domain-specific models using engineering datasets.
• Develop intelligent engineering assistants capable of:
o Design knowledge retrieval, Root-cause analysis, Engineering Q&A, Manufacturing support, Simulation insights
• Evaluate and improve model performance for engineering tasks.
________________________________________
Target Application Areas:
The intern will contribute to AI solutions for:
Mechanical Design
• Design knowledge retrieval, Design rule validation, Component recommendation, BOM intelligence, Engineering change analysis, Requirements traceability
Simulation & Analysis
• Simulation data knowledge management, Correlation of simulation and test results, Failure mode analysis, Design optimization support, Engineering decision support systems
Manufacturing & Production
• Production troubleshooting, Process knowledge management, Manufacturing workflow intelligence, Quality analytics, Defect root-cause identification, Maintenance and operations knowledge systems
________________________________________
data.additional_details:
Required Qualifications:

• Currently pursuing B.Tech, M.Tech, MS (Research), or PhD at IITs or IIITH or IISc in:
o Mechanical Engineering
o Computational Engineering
• Strong programming skills in Python.
• Good understanding of:
o Machine Learning, Artificial Engineering, Data Structures and Algorithms, Databases, Software Engineering Fundamentals
• Familiarity with:
o NLP and LLMs, Knowledge Representation, Graph Data Structures
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
________________________________________
Preferred Qualifications:
Candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas are highly encouraged to apply:
AI & LLMs
• Hugging Face Transformers, PyTorch, RAG Systems, Fine-Tuning Techniques, Agentic AI, Prompt Engineering
Knowledge Graphs
• Neo4j, RDF / OWL, Graph Databases, GraphRAG, Ontology Design, Semantic Search
Mechanical Engineering
• CAD Systems, PLM Platforms, Product Design, Simulation & CAE, Manufacturing Processes, Production Engineering
Data & Infrastructure
• SQL, Vector Databases, Azure AI Services, Cloud Platforms, Data Engineering Pipelines
________________________________________
Research Areas
The intern will have opportunities to work on:
• Engineering Knowledge Graphs, Graph-RAG Architectures, LLMs for Mechanical Engineering, Design Intelligence Systems, Digital Engineering and PLM AI, Engineering Copilots, Knowledge-Based Manufacturing Systems, Simulation Knowledge Management, Industrial AI and Industry 4.0, Explainable AI for Engineering Applications
________________________________________
Expected Outcomes
By the end of the internship, the candidate is expected to:
• Develop one or more engineering knowledge graphs for mechanical domains.
• Build Graph-RAG solutions for design, simulation, or production use cases.
• Create ontology frameworks for engineering knowledge representation.
• Develop AI assistants capable of answering complex engineering questions.
• Establish reusable pipelines for extracting and organizing engineering knowledge.
• Deliver research reports, prototype systems, technical publications, patents, or internal innovation assets.
